E-ENCODING: File is not plain UTF-8 (invalid bytes or a byte-order mark). Save it as UTF-8 without BOM.
E-LINE-ENDINGS: Windows line ending (CR) found. Use LF only; the hash depends on the exact bytes.
E-FINAL-NEWLINE: The file must end with exactly one newline.
E-FILE-SIZE: File is {size} bytes; the maximum is 65536.
E-HIDDEN-CHAR: Invisible or direction-changing character {codepoint} at column {col}. It can hide text from the signer; remove it.
E-PLACEHOLDER: Placeholder {token} is still there. Fill it in before signing.
E-FM-MISSING: No front matter. Line 1 must be --- and the block must end with ---.
E-YAML: Front matter is not valid YAML (column {col}): {detail}.
E-YAML-FEATURE: YAML {feature} is not allowed. Write every value out in full.
E-YAML-DUPLICATE-KEY: Key {key} appears twice. You would read one value while the gateway may use the other. Keep one.
E-FM-NON-ASCII: Non-ASCII character at column {col}. Letters that look like others can disguise a name. Use plain ASCII (punycode for international domains).
E-FIELD-UNKNOWN: Unknown field {field}. Remove it or fix the spelling; unknown fields are never ignored.
E-SCHEMA: schema is {found}; this validator accepts only aiven-policy/v1.
E-AGENT-ID: agent {value} is not a valid id: use 3 to 24 lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, start with a letter, and avoid reserved names.
E-PRINCIPAL: principal must be agent-{agent}@{project}.iam.gserviceaccount.com, this agent's own service account; found {value}.
E-MAX-CLASS-R3: max_class R3 is not allowed: R3 is disabled in v1 because there is only one signer.
E-MAX-CLASS-R4: max_class R4 is never allowed: R4 actions are refused for every agent.
E-UNTRUSTED-INPUT: untrusted_input must be taint or strict. Taint tracking cannot be switched off.
E-TOOL-UNKNOWN: Tool {tool} is not in the action catalog. Only catalog actions can be granted.
E-TOOL-WILDCARD: Tool {tool} contains a wildcard. Name every tool exactly.
E-TOOL-R3: Tool {tool} is R3 (cannot be undone). R3 is disabled in v1.
E-TOOL-R4: Tool {tool} is R4 (forbidden for every agent) and can never be granted.
E-TOOL-ABOVE-MAX-CLASS: Tool {tool} is {class}, above max_class {max}. Raise max_class or remove the tool.
E-TOOL-FORBIDDEN: Tool {tool} is also matched by forbidden item {pattern}. A tool cannot be granted and forbidden at once.
E-FORBIDDEN-PATTERN: Forbidden item {entry} is not valid. Use an exact action (drive.delete) or a namespace ending in .* (payments.*).
E-FORBIDDEN-UNKNOWN: Forbidden item {entry} matches nothing in the catalog or the reserved list. Check the spelling: a typo here protects nothing.
E-FORBIDDEN-BASELINE: forbidden is missing {missing}. Every v1 policy forbids payments.*, drive.delete, drive.share and gmail.send_bulk.
E-LIMIT-SPEND: limits.spend_eur_per_run must be 0 in v1. No agent may spend money.
E-LIMIT-CONFLICT: limits.{limit} is 0, but tool {tool} needs at least 1.
E-SCOPE-MISSING: scope.{field} is required because tools include {tool}.
E-SCOPE-SANDBOX: scope.drive_folder_path must be AIVEN Architecture Sandbox or a folder inside it. The gateway can reach nothing else.
E-SCOPE-EMAIL: email_to item {entry} is invalid. Use a full address (name@domain.nl) or a domain (@domain.nl), lowercase, without wildcards.
E-SCOPE-EMAIL-PUBLIC: email_to item {entry} would allow every user of a public mail service. List exact addresses instead.
E-SCOPE-EMAIL-EXTERNAL: email_to item {entry} is outside aivenstudios.com. In Phase 1 agents may only email @aivenstudios.com addresses.
E-BODY-SECTIONS: Sections must be exactly, in order: Purpose, Why each tool, Data and risks, Enforced rules (generated), Sign-off (generated). Found: {found}.
E-BODY-EMPTY: Section {section} is empty. Write at least one full sentence.
E-BODY-TOOL-UNEXPLAINED: Tool {tool} is not explained in Why each tool. Add a bullet: - `{tool}`: why it is needed.
E-BODY-TOOL-EXTRA: Why each tool explains {tool}, which is not in tools. Remove the bullet or add the tool.
E-BODY-DRIFT: Section {section} does not match the front matter (first difference at line {diff_line}). Run aiven-policy render and read the result before signing.
E-BODY-HTML: HTML or an HTML comment. A policy may not contain text the reader cannot see.
E-BODY-LINK: Link, image or URL. A policy must be complete on its own.
E-SECRET: This looks like a credential ({kind}). Remove it, and revoke it if it is real. The value is not shown.
E-BANK-DETAILS: This looks like bank or card details ({kind}). Remove them; bank details are never stored. The value is not shown.
E-ID-NUMBER: This looks like a BSN. Remove it; ID numbers are never stored. The value is not shown.
E-AGENT-DUPLICATE: Agent {agent} is defined in more than one file: {files}.
E-PRINCIPAL-DUPLICATE: principal {principal} is also used by {other}. Each agent needs its own identity, or one could act with the other's rights.
E-SIG-MISSING: No signature file {agent}.md.sig. Unsigned policies are never loaded.
E-SIG-INVALID: The signature does not verify for signer matthijs (namespace aiven-policy-v1). The file changed after signing, or another key signed it.
E-VERSION-ORDER: version is {value}, but the next version must be {next}. Older versions can never come back.
E-TOOL-NOT-LIVE: Tool {tool} needs the {wrapper} wrapper, which is not live. The agent cannot load until it is.
E-SCOPE-NOT-IN-SANDBOX: Drive folder {id} is not in the AIVEN Architecture Sandbox drive, or its real path is not {path}.
E-INTERNAL: The validator could not finish ({detail}). The file counts as invalid.
W-MAX-CLASS-SLACK: max_class is {max} but the highest tool is {highest}. Calls that escalate at runtime (such as an edit to a shared file) will wait for your confirm instead of being refused. Lower max_class if you don't want that.
W-TOOL-NOT-LIVE: Tool {tool} needs the {wrapper} wrapper, which is not live yet. You can sign now; the gateway loads the agent once the wrapper is live.
W-LIMIT-UNUSED: limits.{limit} is {value} but no tool uses it. Set it to 0.
W-SCOPE-UNUSED: scope.{field} is set but no tool uses it. Remove it.
W-SHADOW-LOW: shadow.min_runs is {value}, below the default of 10.
W-UNTRUSTED-TAINT: untrusted_input is taint. The v1 default is strict: with taint, R1 actions still run at once after the run has read untrusted content.
W-WIDENS: This version gives the agent more room: {changes}.{restart}
